novel_features.name: Held-for-review moderation queue
novel_features.description: Pull every comment YouTube held for review, batch-approve or reject with optional author-ban in one verb.
novel_features.rationale: Combines commentThreads.list?moderationStatus=heldForReview with batch comments.setModerationStatus across pages, plus optional banAuthor flag — Studio requires three clicks per comment; no other CLI exposes this filter.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When automating creator workflows, this is the highest-frequency moderation task and the single endpoint Studio's UX hides behind multiple panes.

novel_features.name: Pattern-based comment auto-mod
novel_features.description: Apply YAML-defined regex/keyword rules (and optional LLM classify hook) to incoming or held comments.
novel_features.rationale: Reads local rules.yaml, fetches matching comments, calls comments.setModerationStatus in batch. Studio's blocked-words list cannot be modified via any official API.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent enforce site-specific moderation policy without manual queue review.

novel_features.name: Daily/weekly analytics digest
novel_features.description: Pre-baked Analytics API queries packaged as a Markdown report (top videos, CTR, watch time, traffic sources, revenue, Shorts vs long-form).
novel_features.rationale: Wraps reports.query across the 6-8 dimensions a creator actually cares about, joins with local store for video-title resolution, formats as Markdown.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Drop into n8n Schedule Trigger → digest analytics → Send Email. One command replaces a hand-built dashboard.

novel_features.name: Per-video deep-dive digest
novel_features.description: Single-video performance digest: retention curve, traffic sources, demographics, devices, end-screen impressions.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates 4-5 Analytics queries for one videoId, formatted as Markdown.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When a new upload spikes or flops, this is the first question creators ask.

novel_features.name: Bulk metadata operations
novel_features.description: Filter the full video catalog by jq-style predicate, apply set/append/replace mutations, with dry-run diff.
novel_features.rationale: Enumerates uploads via playlistItems.list (1 quota unit) not search.list (100 units), applies videos.update in batches. No other CLI exposes the cheap-enumeration shortcut.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Re-tag or footer-stamp an entire back catalog without manually paging through Studio.

novel_features.name: Playlist hygiene
novel_features.description: Auto-add new uploads to playlists by tag/title pattern; reorder existing playlists by view count.
novel_features.rationale: Pattern → playlist mapping kept in a local rules file; playlistItems.insert and playlistItems.update applied in a single pass with quota accounting.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Keeps playlists curated without Studio drag-and-drop.

novel_features.name: PubSubHubbub subscribe + verify
novel_features.description: Subscribe a webhook callback to a channel's upload feed via WebSub; helper command verifies and prints the GET challenge response.
novel_features.rationale: PubSubHubbub is not in any OpenAPI surface; this is hand-built POST + verify-helper. No other CLI does this; n8n integration is the killer use case.
novel_features.example: youtube-pp-cli pubsub subscribe --channel UCxxx --callback https://n8n.example.com/webhook/yt --hub https://pubsubhubbub.appspot.com/
novel_features.why_it_matters: Switches uploads from polling (quota-burning, slow) to push-trigger in n8n. Real-time competitor-monitoring and own-upload pipelines.

novel_features.name: Quota meter
novel_features.description: Print remaining quota estimate based on local-stored per-call cost log, and the cost of the next planned command.
novel_features.rationale: Every API call is logged to a local quota_log table with its declared unit cost; meter shows daily rollup + per-resource breakdown.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Prevents the n8n-blow-the-daily-quota-in-one-execution disaster. Every other command honors --show-quota to print cost before execution.

novel_features.name: Backup own channel
novel_features.description: Wraps yt-dlp with cookies-from-browser to archive own videos, captions, thumbnails, info-json to local or S3-compatible target.
novel_features.rationale: yt-dlp is the only path to bytes; this wrapper handles auth-cookie discovery, batch-file generation from sync'd video list, archive indexing in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Weekly cron via n8n → never lose your channel.

novel_features.name: A/B thumbnail testing
novel_features.description: Schedule thumbnail rotation via thumbnails.set, track CTR via Analytics API, compute statistical significance.
novel_features.rationale: Studio's native Test & Compare results are not in any API. This is the only API-only A/B path: rotate variants on a cron, sample impressions/CTR daily, compute z-test locally.
novel_features.example: youtube-pp-cli ab thumbnails start --video dQw4w9WgXcQ --variants a.png,b.png --rotate 24h
novel_features.why_it_matters: Existing third-party tools charge SaaS pricing for this. CLI replaces them.

novel_features.name: Reporting API warehouse sync
novel_features.description: Enumerate report types, ensure jobs exist, poll for completed reports, download CSV via redirect.
novel_features.rationale: The Reporting API is async (jobs + reports model); no CLI handles the full create-poll-download chain. This command is idempotent and cron-safe.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Drop-in for a daily warehouse pull when Analytics API queries are too expensive at scale.

novel_features.name: n8n recipe pack
novel_features.description: Prints ready-to-paste n8n workflow JSON snippets for the six highest-value automations.
novel_features.rationale: Each recipe wires the CLI into an Execute Command node plus Schedule/Webhook trigger; the snippets are byte-for-byte importable into n8n.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Closes the loop on n8n integration — the user-stated goal.

novel_features.name: Auto-chapters from transcript
novel_features.description: Pull captions via yt-dlp, run an LLM provider to propose chapter timestamps, write back to description via videos.update.
novel_features.rationale: Combines yt-dlp caption pull with a pluggable LLM provider and the chapter-format requirements YouTube enforces in description bodies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Saves 10-15 minutes of manual chapter authoring per video.

narrative.headline: Every YouTube Data, Analytics, and Reporting API endpoint, plus offline sync, the moderation verbs Studio hides, and a quota meter that keeps n8n from burning your daily limit.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps the three official Google YouTube APIs (Data v3, Analytics v2, Reporting v1) as one CLI with sub-modules, adds the high-frequency operations creators actually need (held-comment moderation queue, daily analytics digest, bulk metadata, PubSubHubbub upload triggers, A/B thumbnail testing, channel backup via yt-dlp), and persists state in a local SQLite with FTS5 search. Designed for n8n Execute Command nodes: every command emits JSON on stdout with typed exit codes.
narrative.auth_narrative: Authenticates via OAuth2 device flow (run `auth login` once, refresh token persisted at ~/.config/youtube-pp-cli/auth.json) or via a read-only YouTube API key for public-data commands. The auth flow handles scope escalation — re-running `auth login --scope yt-analytics-monetary.readonly` adds revenue access without re-doing the full flow. n8n calls the binary as a subprocess; the binary loads the persisted token. members.list requires a Google access-approval form separately; doctor surfaces this status.

quickstart.comment: One-time OAuth device flow; persists refresh token.
Pull videos, playlists, comments into local SQLite for offline queries.
Show held-for-review comments — the highest-value daily workflow.
Weekly digest, pipe to mail or Slack via n8n.
Check remaining quota before running expensive bulk operations.

troubleshoots.fix: Run `youtube-pp-cli auth status` to see granted scopes; if the operation needs Analytics, re-run `auth login --scope yt-analytics.readonly`.
Run `youtube-pp-cli quota meter` to see today's spend. Bulk ops should use `bulk metadata --filter` not `search.list` — the meter prints cost hints.
members.list requires Google access approval. Run `doctor` to see status, then apply at the link printed.
Run `pubsub subscribe --verify-only` to confirm the hub accepted your callback; the helper prints the GET challenge.
`backup` shells out to yt-dlp. Install with `pip install -U yt-dlp` or set `--yt-dlp /path/to/binary`.

narrative.when_to_use: Use youtube-pp-cli when you need to automate YouTube channel management from a server, cron job, or n8n workflow — especially for the moderation queue, daily analytics, and bulk metadata operations that Studio either makes tedious or hides entirely. Best when your YouTube identity is OAuth-authenticated and you want one binary covering all three official APIs with a single auth store. Skip it if you're a casual viewer or only need to download videos (yt-dlp alone is enough for that).

recipes.explanation: Markdown digest ready for n8n Send Email body — covers views, watch time, top videos, CTR, and revenue.

recipes.explanation: Dry-run prints the videos that would be updated; remove `--dry-run` to apply. Quota-cheap because it enumerates via playlistItems.list.
